newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Ta Fu IPO seen 200X subscribed - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's Ta Fu IPO seen 200X subscribed - sources.

text.p: The initial public offering (IPO) of Ta Fu International Holdings Ltd is expected to be about 200 times subscribed, market sources said at close of public subscription on Thursday.

An official statement on the subscription results is expected to be made on December 23 and dealing in the shares of the Taiwan-based timber products processor company is expected to commence on December 27.
Ta Fu is offering 168 million new shares, or 20.3 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, at HK$1.01 per share.
The company said net proceeds would be used to finance outstanding equity contribution to seven existing joint venture companies, with the remaining balance going to general working capital.
Ta Fu has 19 joint ventures in China, an associate company in Taiwan and a subsidiary in Brazil.
